subject.title: Feature Request: Stream Repetition Safeguard (Halt & Confirm)

question: What product contract should OpenClaw use when assistant text repeats in a stream: abort-only, pause-and-confirm, retry/failover, session rollback, or a narrower combination?
rationale: The source boundary is clear, but default strictness, false-positive tolerance, whether manual approval may resume suspect output, and how to sanitize session history are product and compatibility decisions automation should not invent.

options.title: Define Core Stream Guard
options.body: Specify thresholds, user alert copy, abort or retry behavior, buffered-output discard, and session cleanup before implementation in the embedded-agent stream path.

options.title: Defer To Timeout Work
options.body: Keep this issue open but wait for generation-timeout and provider-watchdog decisions before adding semantic stream detection.

options.title: Reject Resume Semantics
options.body: Allow a detector only to abort and quarantine the turn, avoiding a manual resume path that might continue looped output.

recommendation.title: Define Core Stream Guard
recommendation.body: Specify thresholds, user alert copy, abort or retry behavior, buffered-output discard, and session cleanup before implementation in the embedded-agent stream path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the closest shipped loop/config precedent and is already the strongest product-review signal in the related runaway-generation discussions.
